strategy.summary: Complete the left five-bank until the left spinner is lit, then repeat the spinner. Build 3x bonus through top lanes when the safer upper route is available.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: Completing the left five-bank lights the left spinner for its high value.

quickInfo.name: Top lanes
quickInfo.summary: Lanes 1, 2, and 3 award 2x bonus, and all four lanes award 3x bonus.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Base bonus builds to 29,000 before the end-of-ball multiplier is applied.

quickInfo.name: Center bank
quickInfo.summary: Successive center-bank completions award Thunder, Lightning, Tempest, and Super Flash.

quickInfo.name: Right saucer
quickInfo.summary: Bank completions increase the right-saucer award.

steps.text: Read the left five-bank and the spinner lamp before the first controlled shot.
From the right flipper, shoot missing left-bank targets until the spinner is lit.
From the left flipper, shoot the lit spinner and assess its upper return.
Repeat the spinner while the ball clears the lane and returns under control.
Use safe top entries to complete lanes 1 through 4 and reach 3x bonus.
Return to bank and spinner work after every safe upper-playfield feed.

fallback.title: Bonus route
fallback.when: Use this when the spinner or left bank creates dangerous center returns.

steps.text: Send the ball to the upper lanes through the safer saucer or star-lane path.
Complete lanes 1, 2, and 3 for 2x, then add lane 4 for 3x.
After completing the top lanes for 3x, return to the left-bank and spinner route.

alternatives.title: Center-bank awards
alternatives.when: Use this when the center bank takes clean full hits and the spinner is unreliable.

steps.text: Complete the center bank once for Thunder.
Repeat for Lightning, Tempest, and Super Flash only while rebounds remain controlled.
Stop after any target return threatens the center drain.

alternatives.title: Built saucer collect
alternatives.when: Use this when bank progress has raised the saucer and its kickout is safe.

steps.text: Complete target banks to raise the saucer value.
Transfer the ball to the flipper that has a clean saucer angle.
Collect the saucer, then control its kickout before choosing another feature.
Complete the left five-bank to light the spinner.
Complete all four top lanes for 3x bonus.
Repeat the lit spinner while its feed stays safe.

cautions.issue: The standups and drop banks can rebound toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Shoot only from a settled flipper and abandon a bank after one unsafe rebound.

cautions.issue: The left bumper exit and left rubber can send the ball toward the drain.
cautions.response: Track the upper exit and nudge before the ball accelerates below the bumper.

cautions.issue: A right-saucer collect is poor value when its kickout is uncontrolled.
cautions.response: Test the kickout before you build a strategy around repeated saucer collects.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Flash ball count, carryover, Extra Ball conversion, and bonus settings.
Test the left bank, both spinners, top lanes, and target rebounds.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Flash, completing the left five-bank lights the spinner for repeatable scoring. Complete all four top lanes for 3x Bonus, build base bonus to 29,000 through safe upper returns, and protect the resulting end-of-ball value.
strategy.overview: In Flash, the left five-bank lights the spinner, while all four top lanes raise Bonus X to 3x. Complete the left bank and repeat the spinner when its feed is controlled, while using safe upper returns to reach 3x and 29,000 base bonus. Take later center-bank or saucer value only when its target rebounds are proven.
machineSetup: Confirm Flash ball count, carryover, Extra Ball conversion, and bonus settings.
Test the left bank, both spinners, top lanes, and target rebounds.
